players.title: Which goalkeeper would you shortlist?
players.body: Select “{testData}” and use the {role} weight profile. Of two 18-year-old keepers, {currentLeader} scores {currentScore} today and {prospect} scores {prospectScore}. Sort by Potential and {prospect} moves ahead, {prospectPotential} to {leaderPotential}. Shortlist {currentLeader} for an immediate start and scout {prospect} as a longer-term option. Potential is an estimate at full development.

bestXi.title: Build a Best XI on a budget
bestXi.body: Select “{testData}” and keep the default 4-2-3-1 with current scores and midpoint transfer values. The strongest XI costs an estimated {unlimitedCost} and averages {unlimitedScore} out of 20. With a {budget} cap, the tool finds an XI costing {cappedCost} that averages {cappedScore}. Scout {leftWinger} for the left wing under that cap, and move {rightWinger} to the right.

squad.title: Where does the squad need cover?
squad.body: Select “{testData}” and keep the default 4-2-3-1. The squad overview flags thin cover at left centre-back. Starter {starter} scores {starterScore} out of 20 and backup {backup} scores {backupScore}. Scout a rotation centre-back who can cover that slot.
